summary: REVISE. Fresh combined definition-review attempt 24 independently ran the SpecKit prerequisite and cross-artifact checks over the exact supplied spec, plan, tasks, plan-review, authorization, failure, audit, Constitution, BMad/PRD/architecture authorities, and current implementation seams. The accepted AD-21 plan remains coherent and failure-29 remains correctly bounded to DeepSeek's legal multiple-function response rather than environment, network, database, timeout, schema, or system failure. All 64 Functional Requirements, 15 buildable Success Criteria, 117 unique task IDs, immutable declaration identities, source-scope restrictions, no-migration rule, and Story 12.4/12.5 exclusions remain represented, with no placeholder or authority conflict. The regenerated task tail is not yet implementable as an honest sole-owner TDD sequence: serial callback GREEN precedes the reservation primitive it requires; the new Core reservation port and host DI registration have no task owner; sampling rejection has duplicate GREEN ownership; and the final fake/deterministic barrier is incorrectly modeled as a broad second production RED/GREEN pair. These four High findings are earliest-owned by tasks and can be closed by one bounded task regeneration without changing the accepted specification or plan. No implementation, provider request, source transfer, database mutation, system change, lifecycle update, staging, commit, or Git-history operation was performed.
